headline: Budget & Finance Committee to review tax classification, grant acceptances, donations, and FY2026 OPEB actuarial valuation reports.
summary: The committee will discuss tax classification, several grant and donation acceptances, a salary deficit transfer, and the City Auditor's FY2026 OPEB Actuarial Valuation Reports. It will also review accounts with expenditures exceeding their authorization.

CITY CLERK
GLOUCESTER, MA

# GLOUCESTER CITY COUNCIL
## Budget & Finance Committee Meeting
### Thursday, October 22, 2026 – 5:30 p.m.
### Harbormaster's Conference Room
### 19 Harbor Loop #1, Gloucester, MA 01930

The public is welcome to attend in person. Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available.
Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/86704580006
Join via Phone: 1 646 931 3860 or 1 929 205 6099
Meeting ID: 867 0458 0006

*Please note that the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the remote connection.*

## AGENDA
### Individual items from committee reports may be consolidated into a consent agenda

1. Memorandum from the Principal Assessor regarding tax classification (cont. from October 7, 2026)
2. Memorandum from the Veterans Services Director & #2027-SBT-3 in the amount of $389.76 for a salary deficit
3. Memorandum from the Archives Department requesting acceptance of donations in the amount of $65
4. Memorandum from the Veterans Services Director requesting acceptance of donations in the amount of $3,720.01
5. Memorandum from the Chief of Police requesting the acceptance of a donation in the amount of $100 to support the Community Impact Unit Youth Anglers Program
6. Memorandum from the City Clerk requesting the donation of a portrait of former City Clerk Joanne M. Senos to add to the portrait gallery of past City Clerks with a value of $150
7. Memorandum from the Director of Community Development requesting the Massachusetts Downtown Initiative Capital Grant from the Commonwealth's Executive Office of Economic Development in the amount of $132,000
8. Memorandum from the Director of Community Development requesting the Housing Choice Grant from the Massachusetts Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities in the amount of $124,300
9. Memorandum from the Arts, Culture and Events Coordinator requesting acceptance of the Mass Cultural Council Grant in the amount of $14,000
10. Memorandum from the City Auditor requesting review and discussion of the City's FY2026 OPEB Actuarial Valuation Reports
11. Memorandum from the City Auditor regarding accounts having expenditures which exceed their authorization & Auditor's Report and other related business

## B&F COMMITTEE
Chair, Councilor Scott Memhard
Vice Chair, Councilor Tony Gross
Councilor, Patti-Ann Page

CC: Mayor Paul Lundberg; Kelly Dolan; Grace E. Poirier; Kenny Costa; Conor MacCorkle; Nancy Papows; Vionette Chipperini; Michael Gossom; Alex Koppelman; Miranda Aisling Hynes
